system: You are an ambitious AI PhD student who is looking to publish a paper that will contribute significantly to the field.
task_description: You are given the following file to work with, which trains a small two-layer ReLU MLP with plain mini-batch SGD on two synthetic 2-D classification datasets (moons and circles), averaged over three seeds. Metrics are final train loss, final validation accuracy, steps to reach 95% validation accuracy and training time. The code is pure numpy and runs on CPU in seconds. Propose ideas about optimisation, initialisation, regularisation or training dynamics without changing model shape, splits, seeds or step budget that can be tested within this setup, with modest changes to experiment.py.
